contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [CONSTAN] TINVS IVN [--] ; R/ BEATA TRAN [QVILLITAS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, possibly of Constantine II (317-340), Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Lightly chipped. Obverse description: Helmeted bust right. Obverse inscription: [CONSTAN] TINVS IVN [--]. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX, three stars above. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRAN [QVILLITAS]. Diameter: 18.4mm, Weight: 1.66gms, die axis: 12
